title: Withdrawal Unstake/Restake Creates MEV Sandwich Opportunity
description: The withdrawal mechanism temporarily unstakes all shares before re-staking the remainder. This creates a window during which MEV bots can sandwich the transaction to extract value from the temporary unstaked state.
impact: MEV bots can sandwich transactions during the unstake/restake window, extracting value from users during withdrawals.
attackPath: User submits withdrawal transaction to mempool
Bot front-runs with transaction to manipulate relevant state/prices
User's withdrawal executes during unstaked window
Bot back-runs to capture profit from the manipulation
recommendation: Calculate and unstake only the proportional shares needed, eliminating the temporary fully-unstaked state that creates the MEV opportunity.
